text:
riley: Hey team, spike of 502s against hostedapi edge starting ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customer tickets saying streaming requests fail mid-response. Spike aligns with LB rolling update this morning. Dashboard: https://go.redwood/dash/edge/502s  :boom:
ava: Thanks. Any trace ids or sample requests? Is it auth vs embeds vs long streams?
riley: One customer posted trace `tx_0a9b3c`. Repro locally: long-running streaming call gets an early `502` during a host restart. Sample curl we used to repro:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted/generate
```
Response sometimes: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` or connection closed mid-stream.
dan: I did the LB rolling update at 09:05 UTC to push nginx changes: tweaked `keepalive_requests` and `keepalive_timeout` and shortened conn drain for faster rollout. Deploy: release/edge-lb-update by dan. deploy-bot: deploy finished 09:06 UTC (release/edge-lb-update).
priya: We also lowered the upstream drain grace from 30s -> 2s to speed up failover on busy hosts (oops). That could drop in-flight HTTP/2 streams.
ava: Short drain + lower keepalive can cause Envoy/nginx to reset active streams -> 502s. Does logs show `upstream reset` or `premature close`?
riley: Logs from frontdoor-ingress node (snippet):
```
[09:11:58] ingress-nginx: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
[09:12:03] envoy: upstream reset before response complete, reason: connection termination
```
riley: Customer repro steps I ran: 1) Start a long streaming request (client keeps connection open). 2) Trigger restart on one LB host (`kubectl rollout restart ds/edge-lb` for that node). 3) Client sees `502` or connection reset when the host drains.
ava: Confirms pattern. Rolling restart w/ short drain will kill active streams. For streaming endpoints we need graceful drain >= expected tail-latency window.
dan: I can rollback the config to previous values immediately. Rolling back now to `keepalive_timeout 75s` and drain grace 30s.
priya: I'll pause further rollouts and revert the config on the remaining hosts.
deploy-bot: rollback started by dan at 09:30 UTC (rollback/edge-lb-keepalive-rollback).
ava: Good. For mitigation we should: 1) Increase drain grace and keepalive to previous values, 2) Add a canary policy that prevents host restart if active streams > 0, 3) Notify support and affected customers with ETA.
riley: I'll update the customer tickets and post in #incidents. Creating INC ticket INC-2026-045 and adding affected tenant IDs.
dan: Trying a controlled repro post-rollback: starting a long stream then cycling one host - seeing no 502s so far (quick smoke).
priya: Monitoring metrics. Drop in 502 rate visible already, tail latencies stabilizing.
ava: Next actions: write a runbook for LB config changes focusing on streaming safety, add an e2e test that simulates in-flight streams during rolling restarts, and include LB drain validations in CI. Assign owners: runbook - priya, e2e test - dan, customer comms - riley.
riley: I'll send the customer communications now and add follow-up notes to the incident. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
